modules.title: Source profiling queries
modules.scope: Builds usp_profile_custtrans_grain and usp_profile_corp_subscription_status, count-only procedures over the external sources, so Mike can run them before the invoice build (Q-021, Q-027). Builds no tables and changes no existing object.

modules.title: Subscription invoice bronze
modules.scope: Builds brnz_subs_invoice and brnz_subs_invoice_line and their load procedures: 1:1 landing with soft delete, row-count check and logging, and the RULE-077 line scope. Does not interpret line types or payment modes.

modules.title: Payment method reference and dimension
modules.scope: Builds the seeded silv_ref_payment_method (reserved ids 0, -1, -2 plus the five methods), fn_map_payment_method (code to id per RULE-007 to RULE-009), dim_payment_method and its load. Does not derive any contact's payment method.

modules.title: Corporate subscription bronze and payer type reference
modules.scope: Builds brnz_corporate_subscription and its load (Round not landed), the seeded silv_ref_payer_type, dim_payer_type and its load. Does not derive payer type.

modules.title: Invoice line-type mapping and currency
modules.scope: Builds silv_ref_invoice_line_type (seeded curated mapping; new codes added as 'unmapped', mapped rows never overwritten), silv_ref_currency, dim_currency and their three loads. Does not compute amounts.

modules.title: Concession reference and dimension
modules.scope: Builds brnz_concession and its load, silv_ref_concession_type (seeded reserved rows and No concession, insert-and-update from bronze, item_code, is_full_concession, is_perpetual) with its load, and dim_concession_type with its load. Also carries the cross-segment reserved-label check over the three segment lists. Does not derive concessions for contacts.

modules.title: Member-year attributes and new event-table columns
modules.scope: Builds vw_silv_eligible_invoice (RULE-014, RULE-079), silv_member_year_attributes and its load: payment method, payer type, corporate_account_ref and concession per contact-year, with carry-forward and pre-2022 rules. Also adds the seventeen new columns (keys and flags not null with default 0; amounts, currency_id and amount_status nullable) to the existing silv_membership_events and fact_membership_events, through change scripts the down script reverses exactly, without writing values or changing any Phase 1 column, row, event_nk or event_id. Does not write anomalies or event values.

modules.title: Segment anomalies
modules.scope: Builds usp_load_silv_data_anomaly_segment, which reconciles CORPORATE_FLAG_NO_SCHEME, DOUBLE_PAYMENT, CONCESSION_NOT_IN_REFERENCE and FULL_CONCESSION_NO_CONCESSION rows in the existing silv_data_anomaly (structure unchanged). Does not touch other anomaly types. Also scopes the Phase 1 usp_load_silv_data_anomaly so that it resolves only the anomaly types it detects itself (answers.md, MOD-008 anomaly ownership).

modules.title: Retire silv_payment_events.payment_source
modules.scope: Removes payment_source from the existing silv_payment_events through a change script, and changes the existing Phase 1 procedure that loads it so it no longer writes the column (procedure named under Q-031; drop approval Q-035). The down script restores both. No other change.

modules.title: Event amounts and invoice matching
modules.scope: Builds silv_event_amount and usp_load_silv_event_amount: amount Campaign Year; one event per contact and amount Campaign Year carrying inv_total_amount from the live brnz_subs_status row as invoiced_subtotal_gbp and subs_amount_gbp (RULE-098, Q-047), the others null; amount_status per RULE-088; and the date-order pairing of events with eligible invoices (including shortfall and surplus cases), kept for the invoice checks only. Reads no invoice or line amounts. Does not write to the event tables or to silv_data_anomaly.

modules.title: Invoice and readmission anomalies
modules.scope: Builds usp_load_silv_data_anomaly_invoice, which reconciles EVENT_NO_INVOICE, INVOICE_NO_EVENT, INVOICE_MATCHES_MULTIPLE_EVENTS, EVENT_MATCHES_MULTIPLE_INVOICES, READMISSION_FREE and READMISSION_NO_FEE rows for amount Campaign Years from 2022, from the match held in silv_event_amount. The readmission checks read the matched invoice's own lines and their line types, never the event amount (Q-042), and use the Campaign Year quarter 2 free window (ADR-004, Q-032). Does not touch other anomaly types.

modules.title: Segment keys, flags and amounts onto the events
modules.scope: Drops the eight amount columns Subs.vwSubsMemberStatuses cannot supply (subs_amount, fee_amount, invoiced_subtotal, credited_amount, currency_id, fee_amount_gbp, credited_amount_gbp, net_amount_gbp) from the existing silv_membership_events and fact_membership_events through change scripts (Q-038; they hold only nulls, and the down script adds them back as MOD-007 built them). Builds usp_load_silv_membership_events_segments (keys and flags from silv_member_year_attributes; subs_amount_gbp, invoiced_subtotal_gbp and amount_status from silv_event_amount) and usp_load_fact_membership_events_segments (copy to gold by event_id plus the extended silver-to-gold check), per ADR-001. Changes no Phase 1 column, row or procedure.

modules.title: Retirement comparison query
modules.scope: Builds usp_report_retirement_comparison: four counts and the agreement rate by Campaign Year over paid positions, comparing the retired concession with the derived retirement date from vw_silv_derived_retirement_date; apuk_retirementdate plays no part. Aggregates only; changes no status.

modules.title: Employer findings queries
modules.scope: Builds the three count-only employer findings procedures (scheme-link coverage, source agreement, top employers). Creates no employer table, dimension or column. The Technical Writer's update for this module carries the employer data quality note.

modules.title: Coverage and totals queries
modules.scope: Builds the four count-only report procedures (payment method coverage, invoiced_subtotal_gbp coverage with amount_status counts, Direct Debit share, last full year totals including the invoiced_subtotal_gbp and subs_amount_gbp totals), each with an as-of date parameter (ADR-003). Aggregates only.

modules.title: Run sequence, regression and handover completion
modules.scope: Builds usp_run_payment_segments, which runs every new load in dependency order after the Phase 1 run. Proves end to end on synthetic data that Phase 1 counts by date, region and grade are unchanged and that results differ only in the Practising / Retired split (Q-046), that a second full run changes nothing, and that every migration passes check and roundtrip. Its documentation update completes the handover and Platform Schema content, including the derived retirement date and the one-off daily rebuild after the first run. Changes no Phase 1 object; a human schedules the run (Q-031).

modules.title: Member status bronze extension
modules.scope: Adds inv_total_amount numeric(38,6) and retired_concession varchar(17), both nullable, to the existing Phase 1 Layercake.brnz_subs_status through a change script, and changes the Phase 1 Layercake.usp_load_brnz_subs_status to land them 1:1 from Subs.vwSubsMemberStatuses ('Inv Total Amount', 'Retired Concession') and treat a difference in them as a change. The key, existing columns and rows and the rest of the load are unchanged. The down script drops the two columns and restores the Phase 1 procedure. Builds nothing in silver or gold.

modules.title: Derived retirement date
modules.scope: Builds Layercake.vw_silv_derived_retirement_date (RULE-099, one row per contact with a derived date) and changes the Phase 1 Layercake.usp_load_silv_member_base so that silv_member_base.retirement_date takes that date instead of apuk_retirementdate, null where there is none (RULE-100, RULE-101, ADR-005). No other Phase 1 logic changes: events, annual rate base, member profile and daily count pick the date up as they read it today. Tests run the Phase 1 loads on synthetic data, compare with a snapshot taken before the change (AC-017-07), and rebuild the daily count with usp_load_silver @RebuildFrom where a test needs past days. The down script restores the Phase 1 procedure and drops the view. Its documentation update records the one-off daily rebuild after the first run as a human handover step. Also adds COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT to the string columns of #ev_stage in the Phase 1 usp_load_silv_membership_events (answers.md, MOD-018 events load collation); its event logic is unchanged.

modules.title: Invoice lines at ledger-distribution grain
modules.scope: Changes the MOD-002 Layercake.brnz_subs_invoice_line through a change script. It adds the five source columns postingtype int, accountdisplayvalue nvarchar(500), mainaccount nvarchar(20), costcenter nvarchar(30) and ricscampaignyear nvarchar(10), all nullable, and the line_id bigint identity. It replaces the recid primary key with a primary key on line_id and a unique index on (recid, postingtype, accountdisplayvalue) (ADR-006). It changes Layercake.usp_load_brnz_subs_invoice_line to land those columns 1:1 and to match on the three-column identity, with null equal to null. RULE-077 scope, soft delete, the row-count check and logging are unchanged, and a duplicate identity in the source fails the load. The down script renames the table to brnz_subs_invoice_line_rolledback_MIGnnnn when it holds rows, recreates it at its MOD-002 shape and restores the MOD-002 procedure. It changes no reader.

modules.title: Invoice line readers at the new grain
modules.scope: Changes the MOD-007 Layercake.usp_load_silv_member_year_attributes in one rule only. In the payment-line fallback (RULE-013, RULE-105), each payment transaction (recid) counts once: its mode, date and settled amount are taken once per recid and never summed across its lines. The down script restores the MOD-007 definition. It also retests, at the new grain, the readers that need no change: the line-type mapping load, vw_silv_eligible_invoice's fee-only test, the concession choice, the segment anomaly load (DOUBLE_PAYMENT, CONCESSION_NOT_IN_REFERENCE) and the invoice anomaly load (readmission fee check, INVOICE_NO_EVENT). It changes none of them. If one of their tests fails, that is a design defect to raise, not a change to make in this module.

modules.title: Daily count adjustment history and as-known-at queries
modules.scope: Builds the insert-only Layercake.silv_daily_count_adjustment, with its columns, the check that not all seven changes are 0, the unique run-and-cell key and its indexes. Also builds the two as-known-at table functions, Layercake.fn_silv_daily_count_detail_as_known_at and Layercake.fn_silv_daily_count_as_known_at (ADR-008), and the review view Layercake.vw_silv_daily_count_adjustment_review. No load writes the table yet: tests insert stored daily counts and adjustment rows directly, using the silver grade 'election' for the spec's 'Qualified' cells. Changes no Phase 1 object. The down script drops the functions and the view. It renames the table to silv_daily_count_adjustment_rolledback_MIGnnnn when it holds rows, and drops it otherwise.

modules.title: Daily count correction of every changed past date, with adjustment history
modules.scope: Adds Layercake.etl_daily_count_input_basis and changes the Phase 1 Layercake.usp_load_silv_daily_count (ADR-007). Each run compares the inputs with the basis, finds the earliest affected date and recomputes every date from there to today, including today and dates not yet loaded, in date-ordered batches. @RebuildFrom and @FullRebuild can only move the start earlier. Each date is written as differences only. In the same batch transaction, the load writes one silv_daily_count_adjustment row per changed cell of a date already marked loaded. The basis is advanced only after the last batch commits, and covered open etl_daily_count_pending_rebuild rows are marked applied. The derivation, the signature, the logging, the producers of the pending table, usp_load_silver and the gold load are unchanged. silv_daily_count_detail and silv_daily_count keep their structure, with no change script. The Developer first confirms Q-052 from the Phase 1 code. Tests compare with @FullRebuild, including the first run after deployment, a forced failure part way through, an events-only change and a retirement date change. The down script restores the Phase 1 procedure. It renames the basis table to etl_daily_count_input_basis_rolledback_MIGnnnn when it holds rows, and drops it otherwise.

modules.title: Segment loads in the daily run
modules.scope: Changes the Phase 1 Layercake.usp_run_daily_load to run Layercake.usp_run_payment_segments as its last step, after the gold step, under the same run_id and with no as-of date. Failure handling, the run's own logging and the Phase 1 steps are unchanged, and usp_run_payment_segments itself is unchanged and stays callable alone. Proves on synthetic data that one call gives the same results as the Phase 1 run followed by usp_run_payment_segments, and that a failing segment load fails the run, with a rerun that recovers. The Developer runs the two Phase 1 reconciliation scripts after one call and records both verdicts in the change note, as for MOD-016. The module's documentation update changes the runbook. It names usp_run_daily_load as the only procedure to schedule, describes usp_run_payment_segments, @RebuildFrom and @FullRebuild as optional manual tools, and removes every step that asks a person to rebuild daily counts or apply pending-rebuild rows. The down script restores the Phase 1 procedure.

modules.title: Corporate subscription repeated keys
modules.scope: Changes the MOD-004 Layercake.usp_load_brnz_corporate_subscription (REQ-022): it lands one copy per (Contact No, Scheme No, Sub Campaign Year), chosen by the four steps of RULE-128 and ADR-009, logs the source rows not landed as the etl_progress_log sub-step 'repeated_key_rows_not_landed' (ADR-010), and checks distinct source keys against live rows. A NULL key column still fails with 515. The table's structure, its readers and usp_run_payment_segments are unchanged, and the down script restores the MOD-004 procedure. Tests cover AC-022-01 to AC-022-12 on synthetic data, including full usp_run_payment_segments and usp_run_daily_load runs. The Tester amends the MOD-004 conditions built on Q-033 (a repeated key failing with 2627, TC-004-018's precondition) to the new rule. The documentation update changes docs/handover/06-known-limitations.md and the runbook (AC-022-13).

modules.title: Corporate subscription rows with no Campaign Year
modules.scope: Changes the MOD-024 Layercake.usp_load_brnz_corporate_subscription (REQ-023): a source row with a NULL Sub Campaign Year is not landed and does not fail the load, takes no part in the RULE-128 choice or the repeat count, and is counted on every run as the etl_progress_log sub-step 'no_campaign_year_rows_not_landed' (0 when none) beside 'repeated_key_rows_not_landed'. The row-count check uses the distinct keys of the rows that have a Sub Campaign Year. A NULL Contact No or Scheme No still fails with 515. The table's structure, its readers and usp_run_payment_segments are unchanged, and the down script restores the MOD-024 procedure. Tests cover AC-023-01 to AC-023-07 on synthetic data, including full usp_run_payment_segments and usp_run_daily_load runs. The Tester amends the conditions built on the 2026-10-26 answer for Sub Campaign Year (TC-004-023 and TC-024-019, a NULL Sub Campaign Year failing with 515) to the new rule; the NULL Contact No and Scheme No conditions stay. The documentation update changes docs/handover/04-runbook.md and docs/handover/06-known-limitations.md, including the recovery step (AC-023-08).

modules.title: Daily count recomputes only the contacts that changed
modules.scope: Adds Layercake.etl_daily_count_applied_contact, etl_daily_count_applied_state_range, etl_daily_count_applied_payment, etl_daily_count_applied_event and etl_daily_count_cell_contacts. Changes the MOD-022 Layercake.usp_load_silv_daily_count in three ways (ADR-011). (1) On every path, each measure is the sum of the contacts' 0-or-1 contributions (daily count form pattern). (2) On every path, the overlapping range guard runs before anything is written (RULE-145). (3) On a normal run, the changed-contacts path (daily count changed-contacts path pattern): only the changed contacts are applied, old contribution out and new in, on the loaded dates they reach, in date-ordered batches with their adjustment rows and cell counts. Dates not yet loaded are first-loaded from all contacts. The basis and snapshot are written in one final transaction, and the 'contacts_recomputed' and 'full_recompute_path' etl_progress_log sub-steps are logged. These keep the MOD-022 full-recompute path, which now also maintains the cell counts and the snapshot: @FullRebuild, @RebuildFrom, a changed reference input (RULE-147, Q-058) and a snapshot not in step with the basis. The Developer first confirms Q-059 from the Phase 1 code. The structure of etl_daily_count_input_basis, the daily tables and the adjustment table is unchanged, as are the as-known-at functions, the review view, usp_load_silver and the gold load. Tests cover AC-024-01 to AC-024-13 on synthetic data. They compare every AC-024-03 case with @FullRebuild = 1 (tables, gold fact except id, adjustment rows), and include the first run after deployment, a run failing part way and the overlap boundaries. The MOD-021 and MOD-022 suites must still pass. The documentation update adds the speed check to the runbook as a human handover step (AC-024-14), and says that the first run after deployment takes the full path. The down script restores the MOD-022 procedure. It renames each new table that holds rows to <table>_rolledback_MIGnnnn, and drops it otherwise.

modules.title: Gold daily fact synced cell by cell
modules.scope: Changes the Phase 1 Layercake.fact_daily_member_count_detail through a change script that widens id from int to bigint, keeping it an identity, its values and its nonclustered primary key (RULE-152). Changes the Phase 1 Layercake.usp_load_fact_daily_member_count_detail to sync the fact with silver cell by cell across the whole span: changed cells updated in place, new cells inserted, cells no longer in silver deleted, unchanged cells untouched, with row counts that count those cells and the final row-count check kept (gold daily fact cell sync pattern). The gold derivation, the other columns, the grain and the silver daily count are unchanged. Tests cover AC-025-01 to AC-025-04, using the AC-024-03 cases through usp_run_daily_load. They show that the MOD-016 and MOD-022 tests on the fact still pass. The down script restores the Phase 1 procedure and narrows id back to int, keeping the values. If any id is beyond the int range, it stops with a clear error and changes nothing.

modules.title: Daily count and gold daily fact at the segment grain
modules.scope: One migration after MIG-0029 that creates no schema (REQ-026, ADR-013). Through change scripts it adds payment_method_id, payer_type_id and concession_type_id (int not null, -2 on existing rows) to the MOD-022 silv_daily_count_detail, the MOD-026 etl_daily_count_cell_contacts, the MOD-021 silv_daily_count_adjustment and the MOD-027 fact_daily_member_count_detail, and widens their grain keys (the fact's unique clustered index to eight columns; no foreign keys; id stays bigint). It adds etl_daily_count_applied_attribute, empties the other snapshot tables and writes the 'detail_grain_restatement' marker row in etl_daily_count_input_basis. It changes fn_silv_daily_count_detail_as_known_at and vw_silv_daily_count_adjustment_review to carry the three columns; usp_load_silv_daily_count to put each contact-day in its attributes' cell, treat the attributes as an input, and restate at the old grain while the marker exists (daily count segment grain and restatement patterns); and usp_load_fact_daily_member_count_detail to sync on the eight-column key. silv_daily_count, fn_silv_daily_count_as_known_at (retested), usp_load_silver, usp_load_gold, usp_run_daily_load and the run order are unchanged; MOD-029 moves the daily count. Tests run the attributes load, the daily count and the gold load directly as well as usp_run_daily_load, and cover RULE-168's cases: the 1 October split, no attributes row giving 0, pre-2022 giving -2, an attribute change alone matching @FullRebuild with its adjustment rows, old-grain totals unchanged, and gold keys and cell sync. The Tester amends the MOD-021, MOD-022, MOD-026 and MOD-027 conditions only where they name the grain (AC-026-22). The down script follows the restatement pattern.

modules.title: Daily count after the segment loads, reconciliation and handover
modules.scope: Changes the MOD-023 usp_run_daily_load and the Phase 1 usp_load_silver and usp_load_gold (ADR-012, RULE-158, RULE-159). usp_load_silver gains @SkipDailyCount bit = 0 and usp_load_gold gains @SkipDailyFact bit = 0, which leave out the daily count and the gold daily fact; with no switch both behave as today. usp_run_daily_load runs bronze, then silver and gold with the switches set, then usp_run_payment_segments, then usp_load_silv_daily_count with the run's @FullRebuild and @RebuildFrom, then usp_load_fact_daily_member_count_detail. Its parameters, logging and failure handling are unchanged, and usp_run_payment_segments is unchanged. Changes check D2 of reference/phase1/Scripts/Reconciliation/pipeline-reconciliation-report.sql to rebuild the expected star with the three segment columns. After one usp_run_daily_load on the synthetic data, the Developer runs it and the unchanged active-member-difference.sql and paid-member-difference.sql, and records the verdicts in the change note. Tests cover AC-026-09 to AC-026-11, AC-026-13, AC-026-14 and AC-026-16 through usp_run_daily_load. The Tester amends the MOD-023 conditions that assert the rebuild switches reach the silver step, so that they reach the daily count step. The documentation update changes docs/handover/02-architecture.md, 03-data-lineage.md, 04-runbook.md, 06-known-limitations.md and 07-glossary.md (AC-026-21). The down script restores the MOD-023 usp_run_daily_load and the Phase 1 usp_load_silver and usp_load_gold.

modules.title: Local group landing, reference and dimensions
modules.scope: One migration after MOD-029's that creates no schema (ADR-014, ADR-015, ADR-016). Builds brnz_local_group_detail and its load; adds rics_localgroupid to the Phase 1 brnz_contact through a change script and changes its load to land it; builds silv_ref_local_group (row 0 Unknown seeded), silv_ref_country_region and usp_load_silv_ref_local_group, which also sets is_reportable and dim_country_id; builds vw_silv_contact_local_group; builds dim_local_group and its load; changes the Phase 1 dim_country load to add the combination rows; and adds the three new loads to usp_load_bronze, usp_load_silver (after the country list, before the member base) and usp_load_gold. The Developer first confirms Q-069 from the Phase 1 code. No member table, event, daily count, annual rate base or fact changes, and brnz_local_group, silv_ref_country and their loads are unchanged. Tests run on synthetic data: the six AC-027 local groups give seven list rows; ids are kept on reload; a rename keeps its id; the reportable test and dim_country_id (Gulf India gets a combination row, Gulf gets the United Arab Emirates row); the view's values for every AC-027-01 to AC-027-04 contact; silv_ref_country unchanged; and AC-027-12, which later modules' regression runs keep checking. The fallback is provisional (ADR-016, Q-068). The grant script gives dim_local_group SELECT to the reporting role. The down script restores the changed Phase 1 and MOD-029 procedures, removes the added dim_country rows, drops the column and the new objects, and renames each new table holding rows to <table>_rolledback_MIGnnnn.

modules.title: Member base, profile and daily counts by local group
modules.scope: One migration after MOD-030's, creating no schema and safe to run on production outside the 06:00 run (restatement by local group pattern). Through change scripts it adds local_group_id and contact_country_id to silv_member_base, silv_member_profile, etl_daily_count_applied_contact and fact_daily_member_count_detail (ten-column unique clustered index); contact_region to silv_member_state_ranges and etl_daily_count_applied_state_range; and all three to silv_daily_count_detail, etl_daily_count_cell_contacts and silv_daily_count_adjustment, widening their keys. It sets the placeholder and pre-deployment values, empties the five snapshot tables and writes the 'local_group_restatement' marker. It changes usp_load_silv_member_base (values from vw_silv_contact_local_group), usp_load_silv_member_profile, usp_load_silv_member_state_ranges, usp_load_silv_daily_count (new grain, new inputs, restatement), fn_silv_daily_count_detail_as_known_at and vw_silv_daily_count_adjustment_review (three columns) and usp_load_fact_daily_member_count_detail (ten-column key, gold country by local group). silv_daily_count and fn_silv_daily_count_as_known_at are unchanged and retested; the events and annual rate base loads are not changed here. Tests cover AC-027-02 to AC-027-04, AC-027-07, AC-027-09 and AC-027-13 through usp_run_daily_load and the loads directly. They compare with @FullRebuild = 1, include a restatement run failing part way and both restatement markers present together, and show that a local group change alone takes the normal path. AC-027-04 and AC-027-13 are tested to ADR-016 Option A until Q-068 is answered. The Tester amends the MOD-021, MOD-022, MOD-026, MOD-027 and MOD-028 conditions only where they name the grain or the region source. The down script follows the restatement pattern.

modules.title: Events and annual rate base by local group, reconciliation and handover
modules.scope: One migration after MOD-031's. Through change scripts it adds local_group_id and contact_country_id to silv_membership_events, fact_membership_events, silv_annual_rate_base and fact_annual_rate_base (existing rows 0 and their country_id; the annual grain and any unique key widened by both). It changes the Phase 1 usp_load_silv_membership_events (values from silv_member_base, and for the Join cohort from vw_silv_contact_local_group; the diff includes the new columns), usp_load_fact_membership_events and usp_load_fact_annual_rate_base (gold country by local group) and usp_load_silv_annual_rate_base (grain gains both columns). event_nk, event_id, row counts, segment columns and every other rule are unchanged. Tests cover AC-027-01, AC-027-05, AC-027-06, AC-027-08, AC-027-10 and AC-027-11 end to end through usp_run_daily_load, comparing with a snapshot taken before the change for AC-027-05 and AC-027-06. AC-027-14 is a human step that the runbook lists: check D2 of reference/phase1/Scripts/Reconciliation/pipeline-reconciliation-report.sql gains local_group_id and contact_country_id and maps gold country_id as the gold country by local group pattern does, active-member-difference.sql and paid-member-difference.sql are re-baselined where region is involved, and the three scripts are run after one usp_run_daily_load. The documentation update changes docs/handover/02-architecture.md, 03-data-lineage.md, 04-runbook.md, 06-known-limitations.md and 07-glossary.md (AC-027-15). The down script restores the MOD-018 and Phase 1 procedures and drops the columns.
